requirements.quote: Check the saved selected IFC against the supplied all-element geometry policy. Use 50 mm minimum clearance, 0.1 mm intersection/contact tolerances and a 1e-10 m3 overlap-volume threshold, with the stated Boolean search budget. Preserve intersections, failed clearances and unverified/missing geometry evidence. Only the explicitly supplied coincident connected-port contacts may receive the sourced witness-region exception; never use it to waive a solid overlap. Other-zone clearance on contact-exempt pairs and BIM-viewer review remain pending. These are synthetic QA settings, not regulation clauses or installed-equipment clearances.
requirements.acceptance: Source model and policy-scoped saved-geometry evidence; complete engineering acceptance pending
